arguments.prompt: Create THREE separate desktop screens for Cesta, a Spanish household suite: Compra, Recetas, Calorias. This is an original professional editorial product, not a marketing landing page or generic AI dashboard. One consistent 248px dark forest sidebar switches the three APPS; only the active app has its own subnavigation. No cross-app panels: no shopping cart or supermarket banner in recipes or calorie diary. Direction established with v0: domestic archive / cookbook / accounts ledger. Warm paper #F4F0E8 background, #FBF9F4 surfaces, #183A32 forest navigation and primary actions, #202724 ink, #536158 secondary, #A94D36 restrained terracotta brand accent, #D8D2C7 fine rules. No gradients, glassmorphism, excessive rounded cards, giant hero, fake AI sparkles. Fraunces or similar editorial serif ONLY for short headings, IBM Plex Sans 16px body, 14px table, minimum13px metadata, tabular numbers. Titles32px. Flat tables and purposeful whitespace. 44px controls. Screen1 Compra / Comparar: exact product identity header (brand, variant, content, pack), search, retailer table with price, unit price, capture date, club conditions, unknown state; separated explicit Alternatives tab. Screen2 Recetas / Mi recetario: search, filters tiempo/raciones/ingrediente, saved-recipe library with authentic restrained food imagery, a selected recipe with serving scaler, ingredients and numbered cooking steps, explicit Planificar and Preparar lista actions. Screen3 Calorias / Mi diario: private personal diary, date navigator, breakfast/lunch/dinner rows, food and recipe add, quantity and editable servings, calorie/macro known subtotal, missing-data badge, weekly bars with a missing day gap and accessible data-table link. No imposed 2000cal goal, weight loss, medical score or red guilt rings. Every screen has a small visible Datos de demostracion label; all sample numbers are fictional, never claims about actual supermarket prices. Include a collapsed Ajustes/Aprender footer link. Keep Spanish copy concise and humane. Generate the three coherent screens, not a collage, not three modules on the same page. No backend code or deployment.
